_comment: Sized to the corpus that actually exists (measured 2026-08-26, scripts/build_domains.sh): web ~9B from 4 fineweb-2 cmn_Hani shards + data/pretrain_full.jsonl, math 0.27B, en 0.24B, code 0.14B, chat 0.05B. `book` was removed: nothing on the pod is a book corpus, and build_mix asserts on an empty domain. weight = share of the first 90% of tokens, anneal = share of the last 10% (Cfg.anneal_frac), epochs = hard cap on repeats of that domain across both phases.
